hero.title: YOUR HOBBY. YOUR ARMIES. YOUR CHRONICLE.
hero.subtitle: Whether it's a 2000-point Grand Tournament, Friday Night Draft, or an epic West Marches campaign: manage your rosters, challengers, and game nights in one place.

promise.title: FREE FOR PLAYERS FOREVER – ACROSS THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE
promise.description: GameTableSync costs individual players nothing—not today, not tomorrow, and not even in the 41st Millennium. Army list viewers, digital RPG character sheets, the live TCG companion, and your global ELO profile remain free forever.

switcher.title: CHOOSE YOUR DISCIPLINE

arsenal.title: YOUR DIGITAL WARLORD ARSENAL
arsenal.description: No more crumpled PDF printouts or endless group-chat scrolling just to find an open table and an opponent.

subListViewer.title: INTERACTIVE ARMY LIST VIEWER
subListViewer.description: Import rosters straight from NewRecruit or BattleScribe. Inspect weapon profiles, unit datasheets, and keywords in one tap.

subMatchmaking.title: LFG MATCHMAKING & TABLE BOOKING

subCrusade.title: CRUSADE & NARRATIVE CAMPAIGNS

competitive.title: FROM GARAGE HAMMER TO GRAND TOURNAMENTS

subElo.title: GLOBAL & CLUB ELO PROFILE

subTournaments.title: LIVE PAIRINGS & ROUND CLOCKS
subTournaments.description: See your table assignment, opponent, and their army list on your phone the second the next round goes live.

subDiscord.title: NATIVE DISCORD SYNC

companion.title: HIGH-SPEED COMPANION FOR EVERY MATCH

chronicles.title: LIVING CAMPAIGN CHRONICLES
